text:
maya: Heads-up — spotted a weird spike in the console "events delivered" metric for a handful of tenants during the 03:20 UTC deploy. Looks tied to streaming reconnects, ordering gets skewed and some events are counted twice.

oliver: Any logs or request headers you can share?

maya: Pasted a sample from one affected client:
```
GET /v1/stream?tenant=acme
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer xxxx
Session-Version: 3
Sequence-Start: 1420
X-Proxy-Session: opaque-abc123
```

harper: Hm — proxy is reusing the same `Session-Version` / session cookie when it replays buffered chunks after a brief disconnect. That means downstream ingestion sees overlapping sequence ranges but same session id, so console dedupe logic misses it.

sre-bot: alert: billing-spike tenant=acme amount=+0.9k (investigate) :rotating_light:

leo: If the proxy keeps the same session id across reconnects we need an orthogonal instance id that increments on every reconnect. `Session-Instance` or `Session-Epoch` could work. Console and billing should dedupe on (instance, seq) instead of (session, seq).

oliver: Backwards compat concern — clients may not send that header. Can we generate server-side? But then multiple proxies/edges might disagree.

maya: Proposal: 1) proxy bump `Session-Epoch` when it tears and re-establishes a client/server stream. 2) ingestion service treat missing `Session-Epoch` as 0 and still accept `Session-Instance` if present. 3) add ingestion-side 10s gap check: if we receive sequences that go backwards AND same session but different epoch -> mark as replay and drop for billing.

harper: Additional safety: if sequence gap > 1000 or timestamp delta > 5m, force session invalidation and request full resync. That avoids very old-kv state from being considered valid again.

ethan: Telemetry note — we need to emit `session_instance` and `seq` as tags on the event pipeline so we can query dedupe rates. Current dashboards only have `session_id` which conflates multiple reconnects.

console-team: UX ask — add a small badge on stream details: "Session replays detected" with counts and a link to raw events. Also expose a per-tenant "deduped events" metric in the billing view (so SREs can see whether spikes were real).

oliver: Implementation risk: changing dedupe key could drop legitimate out-of-order events for some clients that intentionally reconnect quickly. Need a canary and a gradual rollout with an allowlist (e.g., ingress from proxies that set epoch).

deploy-bot: canary-started env=canary-1 deployer=harper sha=ab12cd

maya: I put together a small dedupe filter for ingestion — conceptually:
```python
# pseudo
key = f"{session_id}:{session_epoch}:{seq}"
if cache.exists(key):
  metrics.incr('ingest.dedupe')
  drop()
else:
  cache.set(key, True, ttl=3600)
  forward()
```

harper: +1 on TTL and adding a health metric for cache eviction rate. Also add a debug flag so we can retroactively reprocess raw events for tenants that want a recount.

leo: For routing: ensure sticky routing uses `session_instance` affinity, not old session cookie. That will reduce cross-edge replay possibilities.

ethan: Dashboards: add `dedupe_rate`, `replay_detected`, and `session_epoch_mismatch` panels. Also add an alert if dedupe_rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m.

maya: I'll open RFC + PR with the proxy bump and ingestion dedupe filter. Putting a draft here: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/streaming/+/PR-2345 (draft) :link:

console-team: When PR is ready, we want a feature flag so console shows the new badge only for tenants opted-in during rollout.

oliver: Can we also add a tiny note in the client SDKs about resuming semantics? People assume resume means exact same session, but we should doc that reconnects may change epoch and cause replay-drops.

maya: Agreed. I'll include a snippet for SDKs and update the resume semantics doc.

harper: Plan sounds good. I'll watch the canary and look at `ingest.dedupe` and `session_epoch_mismatch` in real-time.

sre-bot: canary-alert: dedupe spikes observed in canary-1 for tenant=acme — investigating

maya: Thanks all — follow-up: I'll update the RFC with the exact header names and rollout plan. Expect PR for ingestion + proxy within 24h. :thumbsup:
